title: Data Engineering
description: Build the pipelines that feed everything: ETL vs ELT, batch vs stream, ingestion & change-data-capture, streaming (Kafka topics/partitions/consumer-groups, windowed aggregation), batch processing & Spark concepts, orchestration (DAGs, scheduling, backfills, idempotency), storage & modeling (data lake/warehouse/lakehouse, Parquet partitioning, star schema), and data quality / contracts / lineage — each a runnable, pytest-judged exercise.
